items.prompt: Does E[X+Y]=E[X]+E[Y] require independence for finite random variables?

options.text: Yes; all expectation identities require independence
options.why: Linearity distributes over finite weighted sums without it.

options.text: Only if the two variables use different names
options.why: Names do not establish probability properties.

options.text: No; linearity holds even when they are dependent
options.why: The finite-sum expansion does not factor joint probabilities.

options.text: No; because variance also always adds without conditions

items.explanation: Independence is unnecessary for linearity, but it matters for other simplifications such as variance addition.
